Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism, compound_structures, compound_records, molecule_dictionary. Join metabolism to compound_structures via substrate_record_id to record_id to molregno. Join metabolism to molecule_dictionary via drug_record_id to record_id to molregno for parent name. Filter enzyme_name equals CYP2B6. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name ascending. Limit 200.
